pages.text: The surrounding infection remains a flat skin on the host terrain. The bloom spreads it across sturdy surfaces around its base; the shell itself has gaps. Break the source to stop that colony. Its remaining supported tissue

pages.title: The folding colony
pages.text: The Stillness folds a bloom shut and leaves its lining cold. A recovered living specimen can instead be contained in an engine or made into field instruments. Its origin remains unknown.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: Harvest attached tissue for raw flakes. Recover a bloom if you want to build field instruments. Growth lost with its support yields no harvest.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: Infection requires physical contact with living Bloom tissue or an infected body. Merely standing nearby is safe. Leave contact to let early exposure subside.

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: A Disruption Charm, held in the offhand or worn in a Curios charm slot, blocks new infection. String, amethyst, copper and essence make one. It does not cure an infection already established. Infected creatures keep their bodies

pages.title: Work from the edge
pages.text: This is not proof the Bloom was born here. Only proof it has learned to live here.
